headline: Names a US Postal Service facility in Coldspring, Texas, after E. Marie Youngblood.
what_it_does: This law renames the Postal Service facility at 14231 TX-150 in Coldspring, Texas, as the "E. Marie Youngblood Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or its hours.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2016.
